versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides a workflow helper for self-improving, proactive agent-style productivity tasks.
- Supports users seeking practical help with bug fixes, setup, reliability, and skill creation for Clawhub agents.
- Offers concise plans, templates, checklists, and analysis tailored to validated user demand.
- Designed to be local-hardware friendly and easy to validate against clear success criteria.

- Initial public release of the work-productivity-self-improving-workflow-helper skill.
- Provides validated support for self-improving and proactive agent workflows, focusing on reliability, bug fixing, safety, and adjacent workflow creation.
- Outputs include tailored artifacts, reusable checklists/workflows, and verification notes for user needs.
- Uses demand signals and specific trigger keywords for activation.
- Designed for local, hardware-friendly implementation (scripts, templates, checklists) over cloud-only solutions.
